identity.revealRuleText: Full business name, direct contact details, and company branding are shared only after you request a quote and the provider confirms the match. This protects both parties and ensures serious, high-quality connections.

sections.title: Provider Overview
sections.subtitle: A snapshot of this professional's qualifications, track record, and service commitment -- without revealing their identity until you are matched.

bullets.text: Performance metrics including job count, average rating, and repeat-client rate are visible before you commit.
Every provider on Homeworke passes a multi-step verification process covering licensing, insurance, and background checks.
The provider's full business name and contact information remain hidden until a quote is requested and confirmed.

sections.title: Verification and Trust
sections.subtitle: We hold every professional to a rigorous standard so you can hire with confidence.

bullets.text: State and local trade licenses are independently confirmed and kept current in our system.
Proof of general liability insurance and, where applicable, bonding is required before a profile goes live.
Identity and criminal background screenings are conducted through a nationally accredited third-party service.

sections.title: Recent Work Highlights
sections.subtitle: A curated look at this provider's most recent completed projects, summarized to protect client privacy.

bullets.text: Recent projects span residential renovations, routine maintenance, and specialty installations across multiple property types.
Before-and-after project photos are available in the gallery section once you submit a quote request.
Completion rates and on-schedule delivery percentages are tracked and displayed transparently on every profile.

sections.title: How Pricing Works
sections.subtitle: Transparent, competitive pricing tailored to the scope of your project.

bullets.text: Providers submit custom quotes based on the details you share -- no generic estimates or hidden fees.
You can compare multiple quotes side by side, each broken down by labor, materials, and timeline.
Payments are processed securely through Homeworke, with milestone-based releases available for larger projects.

sections.title: When Identity Is Revealed
sections.subtitle: Your privacy and the provider's are both protected until a genuine connection is made.

bullets.text: Before match: you see ratings, review summaries, verification badges, job count, and specialty -- but not the business name or phone number.
After you request a quote and the provider accepts, full identity details including company name, direct phone, and email are unlocked for both parties.
This gating model reduces spam outreach, protects providers from unsolicited contact, and ensures you engage only with professionals who are genuinely available.

sections.title: Communication and Scheduling
sections.subtitle: Stay connected with your provider through every phase of the project.

bullets.text: In-app messaging keeps all project conversations organized and documented in one place.
Schedule consultations, site visits, and project milestones directly through the Homeworke platform.
Real-time availability indicators show when the provider can start and their current booking window.

sections.title: Guarantees and Support
sections.subtitle: Homeworke stands behind every connection with built-in protections.

bullets.text: If a project does not meet the agreed-upon scope, our resolution team steps in to mediate or arrange a replacement provider.
All work arranged through Homeworke is backed by our platform guarantee covering workmanship for up to twelve months.
Dedicated support agents are available seven days a week to assist with disputes, scheduling changes, or urgent issues.

ctas.note: All providers are licensed and identity-verified before appearing on the platform.

rows.summary: Clear scope, clean work, on time
rows.text: Communication was tight, the scope was explained in plain language, and the worksite was left spotless. Finished earlier than expected.
Quote matched the final invoice with no surprises. They documented progress and flagged a small change order before proceeding.
They offered multiple time windows and confirmed ahead of arrival. The timeline was accurate and updates were consistent.
Work quality was excellent. A minor touch-up was needed and they returned quickly to finish it without hassle.
Crew was respectful of the home, wore shoe covers, and kept me updated. Would hire again.
